part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"Recorded observations break the step-after-step dependency, so every (frame, feature) pair is independent and thousands of steered forward passes batch on one GPU; serial closed-loop rollouts are reserved for the few features the screen promotes.","reason":"Screens features open-loop on recorded frames, batching forward passes; only top-5 candidates are confirmed with closed-loop rollouts, removing the closed-loop dependency."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Change the objective from estimation to screening: run a sequential probability ratio test or successive halving over features, killing nulls after ~10 rollouts and concentrating budget near the decision boundary.","reason":"Adaptive early stopping of closed-loop episodes; screening still uses closed-loop rollouts, never open-loop scoring on recorded observations."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"If steering deltas correlate sim-to-real even when absolute success does not, sim becomes a valid screen and the parallel infrastructure applies directly.","reason":"Screens via batched closed-loop sim episodes, not open-loop scoring on recorded observations; parallelism removes serial cost, not the closed-loop dependency."}]}
